description:
The process starts when an employee or department submits a request for an IT solution, such as new software or hardware.
IT assesses the request, checking for compatibility with existing systems and evaluating cost and resource needs.
If approved, IT procures the necessary tools or licenses, installs the solution, and tests it in a controlled environment.
After successful testing, the new solution is rolled out to the requesting department.
Training may be provided, and IT support remains available for troubleshooting.

<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" id="Definitions_ITRequest" targetNamespace="http://example.com/bpmn/it-solution-request">
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_SolutionRequest" name="IT solution request submitted"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_SolutionRolledOut" name="Solution rolled out"/>

  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collab_ITRequest">
    <bpmn:participant id="Part_Requester" name="Employee or department"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Part_IT" name="IT" processRef="Process_IT"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_RequestSubmitted" name="Submit request" sourceRef="Part_Requester" targetRef="Start_RequestSubmitted"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_RolloutNotice" name="Solution rolled out" sourceRef="Task_Rollout" targetRef="Part_Requester"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_IT" name="IT solution request handling" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_RequestSubmitted" name="Request submitted">
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_1</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MED_RequestSubmitted" messageRef="Msg_SolutionRequest"/>
    </bpmn:startEvent>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_AssessRequest" name="Assess request (compatibility, cost and resource needs)">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_1</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_2</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Approval_Split" name="Request approved?">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_2</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_3</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_4</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_ProcureTools" name="Procure tools or licenses">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_3</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_5</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_InstallSolution" name="Install solution">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_5</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_6</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_TestSolution" name="Test solution in controlled environment">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_6</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_7</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_Rollout" name="Roll out solution to requesting department">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_7</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_8</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Training_Split" name="Training provided?">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_8</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_9</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_10</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_ProvideTraining" name="Provide training">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_9</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_11</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Training_Merge" name="Training handled">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_10</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_11</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_12</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_ProvideSupport" name="Provide IT support for troubleshooting">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_12</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_13</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_SupportAvailable" name="Solution supported">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_13</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>

    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_NotApproved" name="Request not approved">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_4</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_1" sourceRef="Start_RequestSubmitted" targetRef="Task_AssessRequest"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_2" sourceRef="Task_AssessRequest" targetRef="Gateway_Approval_Split"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_3" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_Approval_Split" targetRef="Task_ProcureTools"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_4" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_Approval_Split" targetRef="End_NotApproved"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_5" sourceRef="Task_ProcureTools" targetRef="Task_InstallSolution"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_6" sourceRef="Task_InstallSolution" targetRef="Task_TestSolution"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_7" sourceRef="Task_TestSolution" targetRef="Task_Rollout"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_8" sourceRef="Task_Rollout" targetRef="Gateway_Training_Split"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_9" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_Training_Split" targetRef="Task_ProvideTraining"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_10" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_Training_Split" targetRef="Gateway_Training_Merge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_11" sourceRef="Task_ProvideTraining" targetRef="Gateway_Training_Merge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_12" sourceRef="Gateway_Training_Merge" targetRef="Task_ProvideSupport"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_13" sourceRef="Task_ProvideSupport" targetRef="End_SupportAvailable"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
